description: Whether a civil date is a business day, and why. Omit calendar for us-federal-opm (US federal offices). us-fed-banking is the Federal Reserve Banks schedule: a Saturday holiday does not close the preceding Friday. us-nyse is NYSE full-day holidays for 2026 through 2028. us-sifma is SIFMA recommended U.S. fixed-income full closes for 2026 and 2027. An early close stays open. us-ca is California state offices for 2026. Farmworkers Day is closed. Friday, July 3, 2026 stays open. us-ny is New York State executive-branch offices for 2026 and 2027. Friday, July 3, 2026 stays open. Election Day 2026 stays open. us-nyc is New York City offices for 2026 and 2027. Friday, July 3, 2026 is closed. Election Day 2026 is closed. The result includes calendar, sources, and disclaimer. Not legal, payroll, or financial advice.
